digest.component_or_area: tickets store CI checkout and bootstrap
propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall-clock; partial clone with blob:none filter costs 68.7 MiB / 14.3s — approximately 15x reduction
Fetch timeout in Claude Code web environment causes rebar init to silently bootstrap empty orphan store, diverging from origin/tickets and returning [] on all reads
blob:none partial clone preserves complete commit graph and supports merge-base queries needed for identity.enforce_since era scoping without fetching blobs
Fail-open fallthrough to worktree add --orphan must be replaced with fail-closed non-zero exit on fetch failure to prevent silent divergence
git blame over historical trees must abort on any per-path failure to avoid writing incorrect caused_by links from partial culprit sets
